status: Protocol and instrumentation only; no comparative study has been run
controls: same case facts and access to answer bank
separate run directories and cross-task memory isolation
metrics: task completion over all eligible attempts
model token usage and cost if available
current_scope: One elastic verification profile, one- and two-process integration qualification, input/intent fault checks; no model ranking or gain claim
missing_model_usage_policy: Unknown external-client model version, tokens or cost are null/unmeasured, never zero or guessed
evaluation: Use deterministic rule/analytic/reference checks. A generating model's self-rating is insufficient. Unsupported/refused cases are diagnosis outcomes, not completed simulations.
